# temps_load_balancer_route (Resource)

Sends requests for a domain to a fixed host and port, outside any project (a legacy service, another server).

Import with `<domain>`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Sends traffic for a hostname to a service outside Temps.
resource "temps_load_balancer_route" "legacy" {
  domain = "legacy.example.com"
  host   = "legacy-backend.example.com"
  port   = 8080
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain the route answers for.
- `host` (String) Upstream host name or address.
- `port` (Number) Upstream port.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Serve the route.
- `route_type` (String) `http` or `tcp`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<domain>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <domain>
terraform import temps_load_balancer_route.legacy legacy.example.com
```
